brief: A recipe manager as a transformation timeline — ingredients flow through steps and combine into the dish

dominant_strengths: Vertical gradient spine cleverly visualizes ingredient transformation, giving the recipe a narrative timeline metaphor that fits the brief well
Restrained dark palette with warm orange-to-magenta gradient creates a focused, almost cinematic reading mode
Clear numbered step anchors and chip-based ingredients make the structure legible at a glance
dominant_weaknesses: Step 1 card is heavily faded to near-illegibility — sacrificing usability for an unclear focus effect, hurting behavioral clarity
Composition is lopsided: cards alternate sides but the spine sits dead-center with vast empty gutters, wasting screen real estate
Ingredients don't visibly 'flow and combine' — chips are static lists, so the transformation promise of the brief is only half-delivered
fix_priorities: Make the active/inactive step contrast intentional rather than washed-out; keep prior steps readable as reference
Animate ingredient chips merging into the spine or into next-step results to literalize the transformation metaphor
Tighten horizontal rhythm — pull cards closer to the spine or add connector lines from chips to the timeline
Differentiate typographic hierarchy between step title, body, and chip labels with more weight/size variance
rationale.norman_balance: Reflective concept is strongest, visceral is moderate via the gradient, but behavioral suffers from low-contrast inactive states and unclear navigation affordances.
rationale.intent_fit: Partially fits — the timeline spine evokes transformation, but ingredients never visibly flow or combine, leaving the metaphor conceptual rather than enacted.
